content.title: Is ‘SNL’ New Tonight (April 11, 2026)? Host, Musical Guest Details
content.text: Here’s everything you need to know about this week’s ‘Saturday Night Live’ episode.Apr 11, 2026 5:00 PM EDT'SNL'Photo by NBC on Getty ImagesKey PointsColman Domingo hosts SNL tonight, with Anitta as musical guest, both first-timers.SNL will skip airing during the week of April 18.Upcoming hosts include Olivia Rodrigo, Matt Damon, and Will Ferrell for Season 51's finale. Last week’s episode of Saturday Night Live was a huge hit, thanks to official SNL five-timer Jack Black‘s hilarious antics as host (and Jack White‘s musical guest appearance). If you missed it, definitely check it out (especially the opening monologue and the “Husbands” sketch). Alas, there aren’t too many laughs left in Season 51, which ends next month. But is there a new episode of SNL tonight? Here’s everything you need to know before you tune in! Is there a new episode of ‘SNL’ tonight? Yes! Academy Award-nominated actor Colman Domingo will host Saturday Night Live for the first time tonight, April 11, ahead of his appearance in the biopic Michael, premiering on April 24. Domingo will be joined by Grammy-nominated Brazilian singer-songwriter Anitta, also making her SNL debut as musical guest. Who is hosting next week and who is the musical guest? SNL will be taking the week of April 18 off. What time does ‘SNL’ air? SNL airs at 11:30 p.m. EST / 8:30 p.m. PST. Where can I watch ‘SNL’? New episodes of SNL air live on NBC and Peacock on Saturdays (they’re available to stream later). Who else is hosting and performing on ‘SNL’ this season? The final three episodes of SNL Season 51 will kick off on May 2 when Olivia Rodrigo pulls double duty as both host and musical guest. On May 9, Matt Damon will return to SNL for his third time as host, joined by Noah Kahan as musical guest; May 16’s episode will be led by Will Ferrell as host and Paul McCartney as musical guest.
